description: Source code for Windows proxy configuration service in Chromium, handling registry monitoring, proxy config retrieval, and parsing IE proxy settings.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceWin
classes.description: Windows-specific proxy configuration service that monitors registry changes and retrieves proxy settings.

methods.name: ProxyConfigServiceWin
methods.description: Constructor initializing proxy config service and network change observer.

methods.name: ~ProxyConfigServiceWin
methods.description: Destructor removing network observer and clearing registry watch list.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer and starts registry watching.

methods.name: OnNetworkChanged
methods.description: Handles network change events, triggers proxy config recheck if connection is none.

methods.name: StartWatchingRegistryForChanges
methods.description: Initializes registry keys to monitor for proxy setting changes.

methods.name: AddKeyToWatchList
methods.description: Adds a specific registry key to the watch list for change notifications.

methods.name: OnObjectSignaled
methods.description: Callback when a registry key change is detected, triggers rechecking proxy config.

methods.name: GetCurrentProxyConfig
methods.description: Retrieves current proxy configuration from Windows IE proxy settings.

methods.name: SetFromIEConfig
methods.description: Parses IE proxy config and updates ProxyConfig object.
